opening_question.question: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with prominent concurrent manic symptoms (elevated/expansive mood, decreased need for sleep, increased energy and goal-directed activity, pressured speech, and irritability) and psychotic symptoms (auditory hallucinations of whispers and persecutory/referential delusions regarding coded messages in emails and office remarks). Importantly, the psychotic symptoms persisted for at least two weeks during a period of euthymic mood, and mood episodes have been present for the substantial majority of the illness duration, meeting criteria for Schizoaffective disorder, manic type (F25.0).

confirmed_symptoms: Elevated, unusually upbeat mood and grandiosity/overconfidence
Pressured, rapid speech and racing ideas
Auditory hallucinations (hearing whispers of their name)
Delusions of reference (believing emails and office comments contain coded tests meant specifically for them)

diagnostic_checklist.duration_verified: Symptoms have been present for approximately 15 months, with psychotic symptoms occurring concurrently with mood episodes and independently for at least 2 weeks during euthymia.
additional_requirements: Psychotic symptoms occurred for at least 2 consecutive weeks in the absence of a mood episode
Mood episodes present for the majority of the total illness duration
